name: Builder (Claude Code + Design)
description: Lets fleet agents dispatch autonomous coding and design tasks to a tool-enabled Claude Code instance (via the local Claude Max proxy). Internal use only.

proxyUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint of the Claude Max proxy that wraps a tool-enabled Claude Code CLI. Default http://127.0.0.1:3456/v1/chat/completions.

defaultModel.description: Default model alias for build tasks (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-6).

designModel.description: Default model alias for design tasks. Falls back to defaultModel.

timeoutMs.description: Default per-task timeout in milliseconds. Builds can be long; default 600000 (10m).

allowedRoots.description: Absolute path prefixes the builder is permitted to operate within. If set and non-empty, any task whose workingDir is outside every root is rejected. Strongly recommended because the underlying CLI runs with skipped permissions.
